Brokerage protection: $500,000. Market drop? $0.

FDIC insures bank deposits up to $250,000 per depositor, per insured bank, per ownership category.
SIPC protects brokerage customers up to $500,000, including $250,000 cash, when a member firm fails and assets are missing. It does not protect against a decline in value.
Example: $10,000 in stocks falls 20% = $2,000 loss; SIPC covers $0.
157 FDIC-insured banks failed in 2010, yet no depositor has lost a penny of FDIC-insured funds since 1933.

Sources: FDIC; SIPC; SEC Investor.gov.
News and education, not financial advice.
